tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: The newest Raydn stories, newest first. Narrow them to some tickers, or pass since (the as_of of your last reply) to get only what is new or updated.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Raydn stories with a word or phrase in the headline, summary or article, newest first. Narrow them to some tickers or to a range of dates.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One Raydn story in full, by its id. Set related to true for the related news listed under it.
